verdict.rationale: Adyen Risk Management lets users configure risk profiles and custom rules, A/B test profiles, and backtest rules against historical data. None of the evidence documents version history, change review or approval, or rollback for those rule configurations. Backtesting and A/B experiments are adjacent pre-deployment testing features, and case management reviews transactions rather than automation changes, so neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
